decisive_items: leading to suspicion of takotsubo syndrome
akinesia of all apical segments, later extending to mid-segments, hyperkinesia of the basal segments
response.rationale: The clinical course with post-resuscitation ECG showing persistent ST elevation and QTc prolongation, echocardiographic apical akinesia with basal hyperkinesis, and patent coronary stents on angiography strongly supports Takotsubo syndrome. Myocardial infarction is less likely given patent stents and no acute occlusion.

rejected.why: Coronary angiography showed patent stents and only subocclusion of a branch, not an acute culprit lesion; the echocardiographic pattern is atypical for MI.
Ventricular tachycardia is a complication, not the underlying diagnosis.
QTc prolongation is secondary to the stress cardiomyopathy, not a primary long QT syndrome.
